prior_consumed_sample: Six original stocks, 2025-10-17..2026-10-16; no reuse as independent evidence
time_split: First two annual windows descriptive only; final annual window is locked temporal validation, never confirmatory OOS without independent data/PIT/publication/execution adequacy
selection: Use pre-existing 2026-10-17 KIS master snapshots. Per market select group ST, six ASCII decimal digits, code ending0, exclude original6, rank ascending SHA256(UTF8('DF005_V1:'+symbol)), take25. No price, recent performance or liquidity ranking. No replacement for IPO/missing/delisted/unusable histories. GroupST and ending0 are current-stock heuristics, not certified historical ordinary-share eligibility.
stock_split: First15 in each ranked market=descriptive30; last10 in each=locked symbol-validation20. No candidate adjustment from descriptive outcomes; all candidates frozen.

candidates.A0: Exact existing hypothesis_replay A0, candidate-v1 unchanged
candidates.A1: Exact existing hypothesis_replay A1: 5 completed eligible observed holding sessions; original stops/trend/entry/weight unchanged
candidates.T: Exact existing hypothesis_replay T1, the pre-defined simple trend-entry control paired with A1 five-session exit; no new trend parameters

cost_order: fee_bps,sell_tax_bps,slippage_bps,fill_fraction; research scenarios, not verified historical tariff
execution: Reuse frozen V3 replay and ReferencePortfolio. Prior-close limits +/-5%, prior-volume .001 capacity proxy, open+1s assumed anchor, adverse rounded slippage, 1-minute expiry, 1-share floor, no T/T+1 proceeds reuse and no forced terminal fill. Existing source quality flags and receipt dates unchanged. UNVERIFIED_RESEARCH_ASSUMPTION.
special_sessions: In addition to original frozen exclusions, newly verified delayed-open/special dates must be excluded through an explicit derived input eligibility contract; never silently patch frozen strategy/kernel globals. If safe exclusion cannot be represented, mark affected window DATA_INSUFFICIENT.
corporate_actions: Compare full RAW/ADJUSTED histories without treating adjusted close as executable. Nonconstant price factor, zero-volume halt, price discontinuity or calendar gap requires explicit corporate-action/halt lineage. Without it quarantine affected symbol-window; do not interpolate/drop only losing dates. Constant factor is diagnostic only, not proof of no events.
lineage: Store allowed successful and failed response bytes privately with SHA256, separate sanitized canonical hash and normalized record hash, linked per-row provenance; sensitive response bytes withheld with hash/size/category only. Tokens and account/config data never persisted. Immutable versions; corrections link supersedes and actual observed time.

regimes.trend: At decision use last completed index close / close20 sessions earlier -1: bull>=.05, bear<=-.05, else sideways
regimes.volatility: Prior20 index close returns population std annualized sqrt252; high>=.25, low<=.15, middle otherwise. No full-sample quantiles
regimes.liquidity: Prior5 stock mean observed turnover <.5*prior20 mean => deterioration, known prior data only
regimes.sector_leadership: Only PIT sector membership with evidenced availability and sector index returns can define prior20 top sector changes; otherwise NULL/SECTOR_PIT_UNVERIFIED. Current sector never backfilled

risk_comparison: All references same capital/fees/cash policy and .25 cap, but not inherently equal risk. Support requires A1 MDD and ES5 no worse than A0 in >=80% matched BASE and STRESS references; mean exposure difference<=.02 and realized daily volatility ratio in [.9,1.1] required for matched-risk wording. Otherwise report increased exposure/risk and withhold equal-risk inference. Posthoc scaled PnL diagnostic only, never tradable or allocation input.
minimum_economic_difference: 100000KRW per annual 10000000KRW reference net (1% initial capital) beyond A0 for A1, beyond T for candidate comparisons; fixed before new results
statistics: On locked20 symbols and last annual window, average independent-reference paired daily outcomes within KR date, never pooled account. Circular moving-block bootstrap block20 dates B2000 seed505, centered two-sided p, percentile95 CI. Holm alpha.05 primary family3: A0-CASH, A1-A0, A1-T. Cross-stock and sector dependence not counted as independent observations. Report leave-one-symbol/month and semiconductor-exclusion diagnostics. No random split or tuning.
minimum_evidence: At least15 of locked20 symbols, both markets, >=200 common validation dates with21 prior warmup sessions; bull and bear >=30 distinct dates each; PIT evidence for>=3 sectors and historical listed/delisted/halted universe coverage required for market-general independent support.

candidate_decisions.DATA_INSUFFICIENT: Required real price/index/common-window/execution accounting evidence missing
candidate_decisions.EXPLORATORY_ONLY: Usable real price evidence but current-survivor selection, unverified publication/PIT/corporate-actions or observed-open execution limitations prevent independent qualification. Report positive/negative economics nevertheless
candidate_decisions.INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_NOT_SUPPORTED: Adequate independent qualifying evidence but frozen economic, statistical or risk criteria fail
candidate_decisions.INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_SUPPORTED: Adequate independent data, relevant positive primary endpoint passes Holm; A0 net cash excess and excess over T >=100000 in>=60% BASE and STRESS validation references; A1 incremental net over A0 and T>=100000 in>=60%, risk conditions>=80%, gains reproduced outside semiconductor and in both bull and bear, top5 positive dates/symbols each<=50%. Not LIVE or allocation approval

authenticated_collection: NOT_APPROVED_BY_PROTOCOL. Separate approval for exact50 stocks+2 indices, endpoints, 2022-09-01..2025-10-16, PAPER auth<=2 total<=900 requests, response-completion wait>=3.05s. Initial feasibility probes precede expansion; no LIVE fallback or automatic budget renewal.
partial_execution: Preserve original PARTIAL one-share residual. Separate reduction intention/submission/fill/pending/residual/HOLD states. No residual forced fill, new calibrated execution model or profit credit without actual intraday evidence.
